acceptanceCriteria: The scope contract states whether a PATH resource key matches descendant paths, and submit, claim collision checks and set-effects agree with it.

A failing-before test claims with a directory PATH key and submits a tree changing a file beneath it; the outcome matches the stated contract, and a refusal (if exact-only) names the directory-key cause.
body: Observed 2026-10-10 with corvint-tasks (local build 402) completing V1-0782. Declared effects touchPaths included '.github/workflows' and 'docs/build-log'; claim recorded scope resources {class: PATH, key: '.github/workflows'} and {PATH, 'docs/build-log'}. `submit --tree <tree of cd5298d3>` (base 41ed0821) refused OUT_OF_SCOPE naming .github/workflows/ci.yml and docs/build-log/2026-10-09-v1-0782-ci-wiring.md, while the exact-file key docs/specs/agent-harness-integration-v0.md was accepted. After `widen --scope` with the two exact file paths the submit completed (receipt 3927). Expected: a PATH key naming a directory covers files beneath it (as touchPaths are used elsewhere, e.g. V1-1078's 'internal/update'), or set-effects/claim refuse or warn that directory keys are exact-only. Suspected defect, not yet confirmed against the spec's PATH matching contract.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#740 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/740), merged to main at 36f0089a605aaaed2fe0acaf2928f38be263ece5. CAL-V0-024 contract unchanged (key ending '/' covers descendants, otherwise exact); submit refusal now names the exact PATH key that lacks a trailing '/'. Failing-before test TestCALV0024_ExactPathKeyNamesTheDirectoryKeyCause (fails on base 64b5d174, passes with fix, -race). Spec amended under decision 0493. Independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log at the merge commit.

title: submit refuses files under a directory key in the claim's declared PATH scope (OUT_OF_SCOPE)
